dba4da.title: AREA 2 — Session Mgmt & CSRF test results (evidence matrix)
dba4da.content:
Target: http://172.17.112.1:8001 (DiscipLink V2). Accounts: admin ADMIN001/admin123, mahasiswa 2341238901/password123.

CONFIRMED FINDING:
- SESSION-01 (LOW/CWE-384): session.use_strict_mode=OFF. Arbitrary client-supplied PHPSESSID is materialized server-side and persists state (csrf_token stable per chosen id). Login-time session_regenerate_id(true) neutralizes fixation for auth; token also regenerated on login. Defense-in-depth gap only.

DEFENSES THAT HELD (negative results):
1. Session fixation: SID ROTATES on login (session_regenerate_id(true)). Planted SID -> attacker replay = 302 unauthenticated. Pre-login SID dead after login.
2. Logout: server-side destroy + Set-Cookie PHPSESSID=deleted; replay of old SID -> 302.
3. Cookie flags: PHPSESSID=...; path=/; HttpOnly; SameSite=Lax. No Secure over plain HTTP (lab); Secure IS set when X-Forwarded-Proto:https.
4. Concurrent sessions: 2nd login REVOKES 1st via USER_SESSION inventory (CWE-613 fix active). B invalidated when C logged in.
5. CSRF token: STABLE per session (not per-request). Cross-session replay of token -> 419. Empty -> 419. Absent -> 419. JSON body token honored; absent in JSON -> 419.
6. CSRF coverage: ALL state-changing POST endpoints (news, tatib, pelanggaran, notifikasi, upload, logout, login) -> 419 without token. GET writes -> 403. download -> 403 (token-bound).
7. Session-id entropy: 26 chars [a-z0-9] ~134 bits. No predictability/enumeration.
8. Authz after events: after logout/timeout -> /admin/* = 302; role enforced (mahasiswa->admin=302, admin action=403). Direct sensitive paths (views/request/config/.env/storage/keys) -> 403, case-insensitive.
